'''Temporal Interference''' is a [[debuff]] that prevents you from [[Pause|pausing]] the game.

==Sources==
Usually you get this debuff when you are against a [[Pinnacle Boss]].
* [[The Shaper]] 
* [[The Elder]]
* [[Uber Elder]]
* [[Venarius]]
* [[Sirus, Awakener of Worlds]] 
* [[The Maven]]
* [[The Searing Exarch]]
* [[The Eater of Worlds]]
* [[The Black Star]]
* [[The Infinite Hunger]]
* [[Incarnation of Dread]]
* [[Incarnation of Fear]]
* [[Incarnation of Neglect]]
* [[Uber Shaper]] 
* [[Uber Uber Elder]] 
* [[Uber Venarius]]
* [[Uber Sirus]] 
* [[Uber Maven]]
* [[Uber Exarch]]
* [[Uber Eater]]
* [[Uber Neglect]]
* [[Uber Fear]]
* [[Uber Dread]]

Other bosses or encounters with Temporal Interference include:

* Any [[Maven's Invitation]]
* [[Atziri, Queen of the Vaal]]
* [[Admiral Valerius]]
* [[The Black Knight]]
* [[Sasan, the Bandit Lord]]
* [[It That Was Tul]] and [[It That Was Esh]]
* [[Saresh, of the Weeping Black]]
* [[Zorath, Vile Assembled]]
* [[Velka, the Tide Witch]]
* [[The Coven Queen]]
